categories.main_business_segments: Mao Geping Cosmetics Co., Ltd. operates two main business segments: (1) the development, marketing, and sale of premium beauty products—including color cosmetics and skincare—under its flagship MAOGEPING brand and the mass-market Love Keeps brand; and (2) makeup artistry training through a network of nine institutes across China, offering professional education and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on proprietary product design and development, particularly in light and shadow makeup artistry and oriental aesthetics. Product R&D is led by an experienced in-house team and executed in partnership with ODM/OEM providers, leveraging advanced formulation techniques, quality raw materials, and rigorous quality control. The company is also developing in-house manufacturing capabilities, with a new production facility under construction to enhance control over core product lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include consumers seeking premium and mass-market beauty products, with a focus on Chinese women interested in high-quality, culturally resonant cosmetics. The company also serves aspiring and professional makeup artists through its training institutes. Major end markets are the Chinese domestic market, with initial expansion into Hong Kong and plans for further international growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: Mao Geping operates primarily in mainland China, with over 120 cities covered by its retail counters and training institutes. In 2024, the company entered the Hong Kong market through Sephora and is planning further overseas expansion, targeting Europe, America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned downstream in the supply chain as a brand owner, marketer, and retailer of finished beauty products. It relies on upstream ODM/OEM partners for manufacturing but is transitioning to partial in-house production for core products to enhance quality control and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening product R&D, expanding both color cosmetics and skincare lines, and developing new categories such as fragrances. The company is investing in in-house and overseas R&D centers, upgrading its training programs, and pursuing international expansion. Innovation themes focus on integrating oriental aesthetics, cultural collaborations, and advanced cosmetic technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of beauty products via offline counters, online direct sales, and distributors. Additional revenue comes from makeup artistry training and related services. The company employs a dual-channel strategy (offline and online) and operates membership loyalty programs to drive repeat purchases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mao Geping competes with both domestic and international premium beauty brands in China, such as L'Oréal, Estée Lauder, and local high-end brands. It positions itself as a leading domestic premium beauty group, differentiated by its integration of oriental aesthetics and professional makeup artistry, and is recognized as a market leader among Chinese premium brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 3.88 billion, up 34.6% year-on-year, and net profit of RMB 881 million, up 32.8%. Gross profit margin remained high at 84.4%. The company has demonstrated rapid growth, strong cash flow, and a robust balance sheet, with significant investments in R&D, production capacity, and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mao Geping emphasizes a unique value proposition rooted in the fusion of oriental aesthetics, light and shadow makeup artistry, and high product quality. Its differentiation lies in culturally inspired product design, limited-edition collaborations, professional artistry training, and a premium customer experience delivered through both offline and online channels. The brand is positioned as an innovator and cultural ambassador in the high-end beauty market.
